questions.q: Why can the onChange script in this lab only warn the user, not actually block anything?
options: By the time its GlideAjax callback runs, the onChange function itself has already finished and has no return value left to give
onChange only runs after the record has already saved
onChange scripts are not allowed to call GlideAjax
g_form.addErrorMessage() does not work inside onChange
questions.explain: onChange's return value isn't used to block anything, and by the time the async callback fires, the function has already returned - so warning is all it can do.

questions.q: Why does the onSubmit script use a hidden field (u_freeze_check_passed) instead of a local variable to track whether the check already passed?
options: g_form.submit() deletes all local variables automatically
Local variables are not supported in ServiceNow client scripts at all
Hidden fields run faster than local variables
onSubmit runs as two separate invocations of the same function, and a local variable wouldn't survive between them, while a form field does
questions.explain: The first onSubmit call returns false immediately; the real pass/fail decision happens later in a callback, and g_form.submit() triggers a brand-new onSubmit call - a local variable from the first call is gone by then.

options: The function automatically returns true after five seconds
return false is converted to true by the platform after one retry

The GlideAjax callback sets u_freeze_check_passed to 'true' and calls g_form.submit(), which re-runs onSubmit and hits the guard at the top
questions.explain: g_form.submit() re-triggers onSubmit from scratch; this second time, the guard at the top finds the flag already set and returns true immediately.

questions.q: In the full traced sequence, what happens if the GlideAjax callback finds the date IS inside a freeze window?
options: The record saves anyway with a warning
An error message appears and the form stays open, unsaved, waiting for a different date
The onChange script automatically changes the date to a valid one
g_form.submit() is called regardless of the answer
questions.explain: When the answer is 'true' (frozen), the callback shows an error message and never sets the passed flag or calls g_form.submit(), so the save never completes.
